description: This file defines the internal interface IDhtGrainDirectory for distributed management of grain directory entries in Orleans. It includes method definitions for registering, unregistering, deleting, and looking up grain addresses, along with supporting data structures and enums.

classes.name: AddressAndTag
classes.description: Represents a grain address along with its version tag used in directory operations.

methods.name: RegisterAsync
methods.description: Registers a new grain activation in the directory, potentially forwarding to remote owner, returns address and version.

methods.name: RegisterAsync
methods.description: Overload that also considers current registration for the grain address during registration.

methods.name: UnregisterAsync
methods.description: Unregisters a grain activation from the directory, with a specified cause.

methods.name: DeleteGrainAsync
methods.description: Deletes all directory information about a specific grain ID.

methods.name: LookupAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all known activations of a grain, querying remote nodes if needed.
